title: Every accepted Reference gets its sections
description: Finding: all 1,428 accepted References have no curationSectionId; it is only set by a person's vote with a section. The site Cyclotron already has section-fit classifiers and a `decide-site-sections` sweep (`site_sweep.py`, `site_classifier_set.py`); check what it writes on this site. Decision proposed: a Reference can fit several sections; a machine's answer is stored separately from a person's and a person's wins. Fallback where the classifier has no output: nearest section by vector against section mission, labelled as such. Also count a Reference in a section when a Story there uses it as evidence (`section_evidence` does this). Done when: per-section Reference counts are published per run and a person can correct one.
